Fetches and parses Fedora security update advisories from Fedora's public repositories, extracting CVE data from update metadata, modular package info, and Bugzilla where needed.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `FetchUpdateInfosFedora` | `func` | Entry point — fetches security advisories for all requested Fedora versions across `x86_64` and `aarch64` architectures |
| `newFedoraFetchRequests` | `func` | Builds `repomd.xml` fetch URLs for both standard and archive mirrors based on version number |
| `fetchEverythingFedora` | `func` | Fetches and parses non-modular (`Everything`) update info |
| `fetchModulesFedora` | `func` | Fetches modular update info and enriches packages with YAML module metadata from koji |
| `parseFetchResultsFedora` | `func` | Decodes raw XML results, filters to security-type updates, and extracts CVE IDs |
| `fetchCveIDsFromBugzilla` | `func` | Falls back to Bugzilla XML API when an advisory title is unreliable for CVE extraction |
| `isFedoraUpdateInfoTitleReliable` | `func` | Detects titles with ambiguous CVE references (e.g. `...various flaws...`) |
| `parseModulesYamlFedora` | `func` | Splits and decodes the multi-document `modules.yaml` stream |
| `extractInfoFromRepoMd` | `func` | Parses `repomd.xml` to locate a named metadata file (e.g. `updateinfo`, `modules`) |

**Version routing:**

| Fedora version | Source |
|----------------|--------|
| < 32 | Skipped (no vuln data) |
| 32–41 | `archives.fedoraproject.org` |
| ≥ 42 | `dl.fedoraproject.org` |

## Usage Example

```go
updates, err := fedora.FetchUpdateInfosFedora([]string{"39", "40", "41"})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}

for version, advisories := range updates {
    fmt.Printf("Fedora %s: %d advisories\n", version, len(advisories.UpdateList))
    for _, u := range advisories.UpdateList {
        fmt.Printf("  [%s] CVEs: %v\n", u.ID, u.CVEIDs)
    }
}
```

> **Note:** Versions below 32 are skipped silently. Advisories with titles matching `...various flaws...` fall back to Bugzilla for accurate CVE ID resolution.
